sources_considered.why: Reports The Information's figure of $28M OpenAI revenue in 2022 and Altman's December 2022 'eye-watering' cost remark.
Documents seen by Fortune show projected 2022 loss over $508M and costs around $544.5M; context on scale of spending.
Contemporaneous (Dec 6, 2022) independent estimate of ChatGPT running cost: $100K/day, $3M/month.
Later SemiAnalysis estimate of about $694,444/day; context on the size of the $3M/day rumor.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI’s annual revenue reached just $28 million, according to The Information.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's 2022 revenue of about $28M is squarely 'low tens of millions', matching the revenue half of the claim.

receipt.public_excerpt: Sam Altman, said in December that OpenAI would “have to monetize [ChatGPT] somehow at some point,” revealing that the computing costs involved with running the program were “eye-watering.”

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's own CEO called ChatGPT's compute costs 'eye-watering' in December 2022, supporting 'super expensive to operate'.

evidence_items.publisher: Tom Goldstein (University of Maryland), via Thread Reader

receipt.public_excerpt: I estimate the cost of running ChatGPT is $100K per day, or $3M per month.

evidence_items.explanation: The best-known contemporary estimate was $3M per month, not per day. This suggests the rumored $3M/day figure overstated costs, though the thread itself adds 'that ain't cheap'.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI is burning through as much as $694,444 in cold, hard cash per day to keep the chatbot up and running.

evidence_items.explanation: A later analyst estimate of about $700K/day confirms high costs but is well below the $3M/day rumor. It postdates the target period, so it is context only.

unresolved_gaps: OpenAI has never disclosed ChatGPT's actual daily running cost for late 2022; all figures are estimates.
The $28M revenue figure comes from press reporting (The Information via Fortune), not audited statements.
